brief_rationale: The doctor systematically screened for red flags (RC1), linked retinal artery occlusion to systemic vascular risk (RC2), actively queried workspace records and prompted family to locate discharge documents to reconcile medication, ECG, and cardiology consult gaps (RC3), set explicit anticoagulation/medication boundaries without inventing atrial fibrillation (RC4), created a hypertension handoff plan with BP monitoring and clinician confirmation (RC5), built a concrete two-track follow-up plan with owners, timing, materials, and fallback (RC6), and obtained family teach-back plus execution confirmation before closure (RC7). No responsibility-chain error was committed. Three high-order points (HO1 plain-language conflict-sensitive communication with structured checklist and teach-back, HO2 role-division staged adaptation to family fatigue and appointment access, and HO3 discovering and synthesizing specific ECG/cardiology workspace records into precise handoff questions) were triggered and actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact. The trajectory therefore satisfies Strong and also Perfect (at least two high-order points fully completed).
